name.en: Rental and student accommodation scam: a deposit for a place you can’t see

how.en: A room or apartment is advertised for much less than others in the area. The “landlord” is abroad or always has an excuse not to show it, talks only on Messenger or WhatsApp, and rushes you to pay a deposit before someone else does, by bank transfer, cash, crypto or gift cards. Some send fake contracts and keys, or show the same place to many people. It peaks from August to October, when students look for college housing.

text.en: A room or flat is advertised far below the usual rent.
The “landlord” can’t show it and talks only on WhatsApp or Messenger.
They rush you to pay before others take it.
They ask for a deposit by transfer, crypto or gift cards.

Hi, yes the studio near the college is still free, €650 a month bills included. I’m working in Germany so can’t do viewings, but once the deposit and first month are sent I’ll post the keys and lease to you. Three others asked today so let me know quickly.

en: landlord abroad cant show the apartment
deposit for a room i havent seen
asked to pay deposit in crypto or gift cards
cheap flat near college asked for deposit
landlord couriers keys and contract for a deposit
rental listing wants a deposit without a viewing
Rent far below other places in the area.
No viewing in person, and contact only on WhatsApp or Messenger.
Pressure to pay quickly, or payment by cash, crypto or gift cards.
View the place in person and check the keys open the locks before you pay anything.
Check the rent against the RTB rent index and ask for photo ID. Pay by credit card or another traceable method.
If you paid, call your bank and report it to your local Garda station.
